metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. I'm calling about my bill. I got a notice and I need to talk to someone about making a payment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, I can certainly help you with that. For security, could I please get your full name as it appears on the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's Michael Hernandez.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Hernandez. And to pull up your account details, could you please verify the 4-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Uh, let me think... I think it's 5-2-8-1.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's correct. Thank you for verifying. One moment while I access your account information.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I have your account pulled up. I see you have our Triple Play Bundle. And you mentioned you're calling about a payment?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah... look, I'm a bit embarrassed to say this, but I had an unexpected expense come up this month and things are really tight. I can't pay the full past-due amount right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mr. Hernandez, please don't be embarrassed. These things happen to all of us, and we completely understand. I'm here to help you figure this out.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, I appreciate that. I just don't want my service to get shut off. I work from home some days, so my internet is critical.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see. Let's make sure that doesn't happen. Looking at your account, I see a past-due balance of one hundred and ten dollars from your last billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one. I just can't swing the whole amount at once.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. We have options for situations just like this. One of the most common is a payment arrangement, where we can split the past-due amount over your next couple of bills. Would that be helpful?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You can do that? That would be a huge help. How does it work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I just need to check your account's eligibility for the program. It usually takes about thirty seconds. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Hernandez. The good news is your account is in good standing and you are fully eligible for a payment arrangement.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's a relief. Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, we can take that one-hundred-and-ten-dollar balance and split it into two equal installments. That would be fifty-five dollars added to your next bill, and fifty-five dollars added to the bill after that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So my next bill will be my regular amount plus fifty-five dollars?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly right. Your regular monthly service charge for the Triple Play bundle is one hundred and ten dollars. So your next invoice would total one hundred sixty-five dollars.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... one sixty-five. I can do that. And then the same for the month after?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct again. And after that second payment, your account will be fully caught up and you'll go back to your normal one-hundred-ten-dollar monthly bill, assuming no other changes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds perfect. Yes, let's please do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Before I finalize this, I do need to let you know that the arrangement requires each of these payments to be made on time. If a payment is missed, the arrangement is voided and the full remaining balance would become due immediately to avoid interruption.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I understand. I'll make sure they're paid on time. I'll mark it on my calendar right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Also, I'm looking here and I see the system automatically applied a ten-dollar late fee to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, right. I figured that would happen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, since you called us to proactively set up this plan, and because you've been a loyal Cymbal Telecom customer, I'm going to go ahead and waive that ten-dollar fee for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Really? Wow, thank you so much. That's very kind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Let me just process that credit for you... one moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the ten-dollar late fee has been removed. Now I am setting up the payment arrangement for the one-hundred-ten-dollar balance. Do I have your verbal consent to establish this two-month payment plan on your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, you absolutely have my consent. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I am clicking 'submit' now... and... it is confirmed. The payment arrangement is now active on your account, Mr. Hernandez. Your services are protected from interruption.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is such a weight off my shoulders. I can't thank you enough, Jessica.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure to help. So, just to recap everything for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have successfully set up a payment arrangement to split your past-due balance of one hundred and ten dollars into two installments.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your next bill will include your regular monthly charge plus an installment of fifty-five dollars.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The following bill will have your regular charge plus the final installment of fifty-five dollars.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Understood.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And I have successfully waived the ten-dollar late fee, so that charge is gone.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's fantastic.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You should see these changes reflected on your online Cymbal account portal within the hour, and I'm also sending a confirmation email to the address we have on file, michael.hernandez@telecom-personal.com. Is that still correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one. An email confirmation would be great for my records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The email has just been sent. You should receive it shortly. It will have all the details of the arrangement we just discussed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. This was so much easier and less stressful than I expected. You've been incredibly helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so glad I could assist you, Mr. Hernandez. We value your business and want to work with you when things get tough. Is there anything else I can help you with today? Any questions about your TV service, internet speed, or anything at all?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's all. You've solved my big problem for the day, and I'm very grateful. That's all I needed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Well, thank you for being a Cymbal Telecom customer, and thank you for calling to work with us on this. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, Jessica. Thanks again. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
